messages:
clare: quick topic  pick a canonical approach for hosted/dedicated/private capability discovery. i propose we standardize on a "manifest+probe" pattern (manifest=install-time signed file, probe=optional runtime endpoint).

anita: short rationale: manifests cover air-gapped installs; probes give freshness in VPCs. combined model lets control-plane make routing decisions using an attestation level.

marc: security concern: operator could fake runtime probes. we need attestation levels: NONE, SIGNED_MANIFEST, ATTESTED_PROBE. routing rules tighten with weaker attestation.

yuki: observability: emit hashed tenant id + capability_fingerprint; labels: attestation_level. metric names: runtime.probe.ok, runtime.manifest.verify.fail, routing.degraded. avoid plaintext tenant values.

clare: feature matrix idea: list which capabilities require sidecar vs probe-only. quick draft: local-prefix-cache -> sidecar required; offline-retry -> sidecar recommended; streaming & basic generation -> probe-only ok.

anita: probe contract basics: GET /v1/probe returns capabilities + timestamp + nonce + signature_kid. TTL 30-120s. signature should be HSM/KMS-backed when available; otherwise control-plane issues short-lived lease after validating probe.

marc: replay protection: nonce + bind to TLS client cert or source IP when possible. if none, rely on short TTL and anomaly detection.

ops-bot: ops checklist: (1) upload signed manifest at install, (2) optionally enable probe endpoint on mgmt VLAN, (3) enable mTLS for probe if reachable, (4) document opt-in attestation flow.

clare: disagreement resolution: precedence = ATTESTED_PROBE > SIGNED_MANIFEST > NONE. if manifest and probe disagree, mark capability as degraded and route conservatively. create an incident if routing failures follow.

yuki: include a small sample manifest snippet in RFC and a one-page state machine for routing inputs -> attestation -> outcome. also define metric thresholds for auto-remediation.

anita: will draft the RFC with diagrams and sample JSON snippets. plan review next Tue. any objections to calling it "manifest+probe"?

marc: +1 from security side pending detailed claims list.

yuki: +1.

ops-bot: created ticket INF-2001: manifest-probe-routing, attached this thread.
